groups.description: Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy with bullous changes; 43 eyes; non-Descemet-stripping automated endothelial keratoplasty (nDSAEK): 7.5 or 8.0 mm posterior lamellar graft cut with a microkeratome or a femtosecond laser, host Descemet membrane not stripped, glide insertion through a 5-mm temporal tunnel, 10-0 nylon sutures, intracameral air; single surgeon; retrospective 2007-2025; same-session cataract surgery not stated

Corneal endothelial decompensation secondary to cataract surgery (pseudophakic bullous keratopathy), including 6 eyes with prior ocular trauma surgery, 4 post-vitrectomy and 1 after a previous corneal transplantation (a repeat keratoplasty), hence indication mixed; 71 eyes; eyes already operated for cataract, so no same-session cataract surgery; non-Descemet-stripping automated endothelial keratoplasty (nDSAEK): 7.5 or 8.0 mm posterior lamellar graft cut with a microkeratome or a femtosecond laser, host Descemet membrane not stripped, glide insertion through a 5-mm temporal tunnel, 10-0 nylon sutures, intracameral air; single surgeon; retrospective 2007-2025

notes: Procedure context dsaek: nDSAEK is the DSAEK graft (automated posterior lamellar stroma-carrying graft) without stripping the host Descemet membrane, a DSAEK variant per the protocol scope; it is not nanothin DSAEK.
The 15 graft failures, 4 rejections, 7 recurrent bullous changes and 3 rebubblings occurred within the 114-eye cohort, which is not restricted by outcome.

Exclusion criteria were preoperative (trauma, ocular hypertension, infectious keratitis, systemic disease or immunosuppression, comorbidity limiting visual potential, high failure risk) plus 'patients unable to adhere to the designated follow-up protocols'; follow-up length varies (median 41.50 months, IQR 25.65-55.75), so the set is not restricted to eyes completing every tabulated visit.
The Statistical Analysis section mentions linear mixed-effects models for BCVA; Table 2 prints mean ± SD with between-group t-test or Mann-Whitney p-values and is read as descriptive group means.
Table 1 tabulates endothelial cell density and central corneal thickness (preoperative to 36 months); not used.
114 eyes of 114 patients; the article's Table 3 summarises the indications as BK/PBK 62.3% and Fuchs 37.7%.
